{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data
df.info()
df.head()

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f"Number of unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()}")

# Check assay_batch effect on baseline (should not matter)
print(f"Unique assay_batch values: {df['assay_batch'].unique()}")
print(f"Distribution of assay_batch by biomarker_baseline (excluding -999):\n{df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]['assay_batch'].value_counts()}")

# Check sample_seq for retesting
print(f"Max sample_seq per patient: {df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().value_counts()}")

# Check severity distribution
print(f"Severity distribution: {df['severity'].value_counts().to_dict()}")

# Note: We will deduplicate by keeping highest sample_seq per patient
# and exclude -999 in baseline

# Check if there are any patients with multiple rows and sample_seq > 1
retested_patients = df[df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
print(f"Number of retested patients (multiple rows): {retested_patients['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Confirm: we will keep row with highest sample_seq per patient
# and filter out -999 in biomarker_baseline

# Deduplicate by keeping highest sample_seq per patient
# and exclude -999 in baseline

# First, filter out -999
filtered_df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Then deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
deduplicated_df = filtered_df.loc[filtered_df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now check final number of patients
print(f"Final number of patients after deduplication: {len(deduplicated_df)}")

# Compute mean baseline biomarker
mean_baseline = deduplicated_df['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print final result
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker (ng/mL) across all patients: {mean_baseline}")

# Return the mean
mean_baseline"}
